game.title: Doom
game.blurb: First-person shooter from id Software (RAWG also lists Panic Button, Tango Gameworks and others), published by Bethesda Softworks, released 2016-05-12. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Doom_(2016)
Fandom (doom.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://doom.fandom.com/wiki/Doom_(2016)
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the 2016 game ("DOOM (2016)", slug "doom"), as expected; RAWG keeps the 1993 game separately. Steam app 379720 is named "DOOM" in the schema and store list. StrategyWiki has "Doom (2016)" at completion stage 1, but its Walkthrough is not a usable guide: the Walkthrough page itself and the first mission page are not written, and the other 12 mission pages are short stubs (marked as stubs, each about 500 to 1,000 characters) with a mission briefing and the challenge list but no walkthrough text. Its Gameplay, Weapons, Runes, Praetor Suit and Achievements pages are written; Collectibles, Monsters and Arcade Mode are not. So it was not used. doom.fandom.com answers the API under "Doom (2016)" with about 216 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 5 of 54 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the campaign chapter. 22 achievements are multiplayer, SnapMap or Arcade Mode, all below 12%; the multiplayer taunts and armor name "Expansion 1" to "Expansion 3" without titles.
